Loops over the bands, filter taps or small state arrays (at most 21 or 16 trips) carry SHORT_LOOP.

silk_autocorr() takes the scratch arena; SILK_PITCH_SCRATCH_BYTES is the size silk_pitch_analysis_core() needs, and that function takes no sampling rate or subframe count (16 kHz, four subframes). silk_resampler_down2_3() is removed (only the 12 kHz pitch analysis used it).

The internal rate is always 16 kHz and a packet one 20 ms frame: silk_control_encoder() takes the channel state and the control structure and sets the complexity, the packet loss rate and the LBRR usage before every packet. The frame parameters and the 48 to 16 kHz resampler are set once in silk_init_encoder() with constants; silk_setup_fs(), the per-packet control guard and silk_control_audio_bandwidth(), silk_setup_resamplers() and their rate-switch path are removed.

silk_setup_complexity() is a table of six rows (silk_complexity_table) indexed by the complexity 1-10; it has no complexity 0 tier (silk_NSQ_del_dec() is the only quantizer) and no limit of the pitch estimation order by the prediction order (always 16).

The LPC synthesis is silk_LPC_synthesis(): taps 0 and 1 scalar, taps 2..15 a vector dot product over a sliding history of the samples split into signed high and low 16-bit halves. Exact, because (x * a) >> 16 = hi * a + ((lo * a) >> 16) with lo unsigned; sums wrap in 32 bits like the scalar silk_SMLAWB chain. SILK decode 30,872 -> 25,168 cycles per frame.
silk_decode_frame() takes no run-time architecture argument.
silk_decoder_control and the pulses buffer (MAX_FRAME_LENGTH samples, the largest padded frame) are fixed locals instead of ALLOCs; the scratch arena goes to silk_decode_core() and silk_PLC().
silk_NLSF2A() is called without the arch argument.

The sample rate, subframe count and frame length checks use celt_packet_check().
No DTX: NB_SPEECH_FRAMES_BEFORE_DTX, MAX_CONSECUTIVE_DTX and DTX_ACTIVITY_THRESHOLD are removed.
NLSF_MSVQ_MAX_SURVIVORS (16), the largest survivor count silk_setup_complexity() sets.
The transition filter constants (TRANSITION_*) are removed.
LTP_MEM_LENGTH (the encoder's LTP memory in samples); MAX_FRAMES_PER_PACKET is the decoder's maximum, the encoder codes one frame.
No DTX: the per-channel DTX flag is not set and silk_Encode() never returns zero bytes for DTXed channels.
silk_InitEncoder() takes no status structure (silk_QueryEncoder() is removed) and does not clear the state, which the caller cleared; silk_init_encoder() takes no run-time architecture argument.

silk_Encode() takes the scratch arena (SILK_ENCODER_SCRATCH_BYTES, proved by _Static_asserts over the three call paths); the per-frame scratch overlaps the input buffer, which is dead once the frame is resampled into the encoder state.

One 20 ms frame of 48 kHz PCM per call: multi-frame LBRR flags, per-block bit shaping, the in-packet bit balance, the prefill, the input buffering across calls (input index, frame counter, sample count and the input length checks) and the audio bandwidth switching state (allowBandwidthSwitch, timeSinceSwitchAllowed_ms) are removed. The LBRR flag is one bit per channel (LBRR_pending for the next packet, LBRR_flag for this one).
Every frame is coded independently of the previous one (conditional coding of gains, pitch lag and LTP scale is never selected), so there is no coding type and no side channel exception to it.
No reduced-dependency mode; no constant-bitrate flag.
check_control_input() is not called (and not kept): opus_encoder.c sets every control field within its range (validated loss, FEC and complexity).

A mono input is resampled from the caller's PCM without the intermediate copy; the resampler state copy at a mono to stereo transition and the unused high-pass filter state copy are removed (the transition copies the first channel's resampler state when the stereo branch starts). silk_Encode() and silk_InitEncoder() return nothing: neither can fail.

silk_encode_indices() takes only the LBRR flag: every frame is coded independently (the first gain, the absolute pitch lag and the LTP scale are always sent in full), the wideband NLSF codebook, pitch tables and four subframes are constants, and the previous pitch lag and signal type are not kept.

abs_pulses, sum_pulses and nRshifts are fixed local arrays sized for MAX_FRAME_LENGTH samples instead of ALLOCs (a frame has at most MAX_FRAME_LENGTH samples, so iter * SHELL_CODEC_FRAME_LENGTH fits).
silk_encode_pulses() takes no frame length: a frame is MAX_FRAME_LENGTH samples, always MAX_NB_SHELL_BLOCKS shell blocks (the 10 ms 12 kHz padding is removed).
silk_LTP_analysis_filter_FIX() takes no subframe length, count or pre-length: four subframes of MAX_SUB_FRAME_LENGTH, each with MAX_LPC_ORDER samples before it.
silk_LTP_scale_ctrl_FIX() takes no coding type (every frame is independent, so the LTP scaling is always chosen from the loss rate) and counts one frame per packet.
silk_autocorr() takes no run-time architecture argument.
silk_autocorr() takes the scratch arena and passes it to _celt_autocorr().
silk_corrVector_FIX() and silk_corrMatrix_FIX() take no run-time architecture argument.
No DTX: the VAD result sets only the VAD flag (no noSpeechCounter or inDTX).

silk_VAD_GetSA_Q8(), silk_NSQ_del_dec(), silk_find_pitch_lags_FIX() and silk_noise_shape_analysis_FIX() are called without the arch argument.

silk_burg_modified(), silk_NLSF2A() and silk_LPC_analysis_filter() are called without the arch argument; the LPC order, subframe length and the four subframes are constants.

The prototypes of the encoder functions take the scratch arena.
silk_warped_autocorrelation_FIX() is declared directly (the SSE4.1 kernel, no arch argument), without the _c name and the OVERRIDE_ dispatch macro.

silk_control_encoder() takes the channel state and the control structure, silk_init_encoder() returns nothing, and the encoder functions take no coding type, constant-bitrate flag, subframe count, subframe length or order (silk_find_pred_coefs_FIX(), silk_process_gains_FIX(), silk_LTP_scale_ctrl_FIX(), silk_find_LTP_FIX(), silk_LTP_analysis_filter_FIX(), silk_residual_energy_FIX(), silk_encode_frame_FIX()).
x_windowed is a fixed local array of SHAPE_LPC_WIN_MAX samples instead of an ALLOC; the scratch arena goes to silk_autocorr().
silk_noise_shape_analysis_FIX() takes no run-time architecture argument; silk_warped_autocorrelation_FIX() and silk_autocorr() are called without one.
The constant-bitrate branch, the rate, subframe count and subframe length are removed or constants.
silk_pitch_analysis_core(), silk_P_Ana_calc_corr_st3() and silk_P_Ana_calc_energy_st3() take no run-time architecture argument.
silk_pitch_analysis_core() takes the scratch arena (SILK_PITCH_SCRATCH_BYTES, proved by a _Static_assert); the stage helpers' scratch_mem buffer is a fixed local array.
The signal is always 16 kHz with four subframes: the 8 and 12 kHz resampling paths, the 10 ms codebooks and the sampling rate and subframe count arguments are removed.
silk_process_gains_FIX() takes no coding type (the first gain is always coded in full), and the subframe count and length are constants.
silk_residual_energy_FIX() takes no run-time architecture argument.
LPC_res is a fixed local array of (MAX_NB_SUBFR / 2) * (MAX_SUB_FRAME_LENGTH + MAX_LPC_ORDER) samples instead of an ALLOC.
silk_residual_energy_FIX() takes no subframe length, subframe count or LPC order (constants).
silk_encoder loses timeSinceSwitchAllowed_ms, allowBandwidthSwitch and nChannelsAPI; silk_shape_state_FIX loses HarmBoost_smth_Q16 and silk_encoder_state_FIX loses resNrgSmth (written, never read).
silk_inner_prod_aligned() takes no run-time architecture argument.
silk_inner_prod16_c() removed: silk_inner_prod16() is the SSE4.1 kernel of x86/vector_ops_FIX_sse4_1.c.
silk_scale_vector32_Q26_lshift_18() (unused) removed.

silk_warped_autocorrelation_FIX_c() is renamed silk_warped_autocorrelation_FIX() and runs four consecutive samples as an SSE4.1 wavefront (lane k holds tap d - k of sample n + k at step d; pmaddwd and pmulhuw form silk_SMLAWB() exactly); corr_QC is the exact 64-bit sum of the products minus the sum of their dropped low bits, shifted once, which equals upstream's sum of shifted products. Samples past a multiple of four run upstream's scalar loop.

silk_burg_modified_sse4_1() is renamed silk_burg_modified(); its C twin burg_modified_FIX.c is deleted (the build requires SSE4.1, so it never ran). It takes no run-time architecture argument and calls celt_pitch_xcorr() and silk_inner_prod_aligned() without one.
silk_inner_prod16_sse4_1() is renamed silk_inner_prod16().
silk_gains_quant() and silk_gains_ID() take no subframe count (four subframes) and silk_gains_quant() no coding flag: the first gain is always coded in full.
opus_select_arch() is not called (no run-time architecture field).

silk_init_encoder() takes no run-time architecture argument (cpu_support.h, deleted, is not included), returns nothing and also prepares the fixed configuration once: the 48 to 16 kHz resampler and the non-zero initial values of the previous lag, gain index and NSQ state (formerly set at the first control call).
silk_interpolate() takes no order: it interpolates MAX_LPC_ORDER values.
silk_quant_LTP_gains(), silk_decode_frame() and silk_decode_core() take no run-time architecture argument.

No x86/main_sse.h (deleted): SSE4.1 is required (no OPUS_X86_PRESUME_SSE4_1 check), and silk_NSQ_del_dec(), silk_VQ_WMat_EC(), silk_VAD_GetSA_Q8() and silk_VAD_GetNoiseLevels() are declared directly, without the _c names, arch dispatch macros and OVERRIDE_ layers.
silk_NSQ_del_dec() and silk_stereo_LR_to_MS() take the scratch arena; SILK_NSQ_SCRATCH_BYTES is the size silk_NSQ_del_dec() needs (proved by _Static_asserts in NSQ_del_dec_sse4_1.c and enc_API.c).
check_control_input() is not declared (enc_API.c).
silk_NSQ(), silk_control_audio_bandwidth() and silk_LP_variable_cutoff() are not declared (removed).

The encoder functions take no frame length, subframe count, order, rate or coding type (silk_stereo_LR_to_MS(), silk_stereo_find_predictor(), silk_encode_pulses(), silk_gains_quant(), silk_gains_ID(), silk_interpolate(), silk_quant_LTP_gains(), silk_VQ_WMat_EC(), silk_encode_indices()); silk_VAD_Init(), silk_VAD_GetSA_Q8() and silk_control_SNR() return nothing.
silk_NLSF2A() is called without the arch argument.
The wideband codebook, order 16 and the 20 ms rate weight are constants: no 10 ms adjustment, silk_interpolate() and the NLSF weights take no order.
silk_quant_LTP_gains() takes no run-time architecture argument, no subframe length or count (constants), and calls silk_VQ_WMat_EC() without one.
silk_resampler() takes the scratch arena and passes it to the resampler kernels.
silk_resampler()'s input length check uses celt_packet_check().

The API rate is 48 kHz on both sides: silk_resampler_init() sets up only 48 kHz to 16 kHz (AR2 and FIR decimation by 3, delay 12) and 8, 12 or 16 kHz to 48 kHz (2x upsampling followed by FIR interpolation), with one-dimensional delay tables; the plain 2x upsampling mode, the 3:4, 2:3 and 1:2 decimators and the copy setup are removed. silk_resampler() still copies for a cleared state, as upstream does.
silk_resampler_private_IIR_FIR() and silk_resampler_private_down_FIR() take the scratch arena.
silk_resampler_private_up2_HQ_wrapper() (2x upsampling resampler mode) is removed.

The interpolation computes four outputs per step: one pmaddwd of the eight samples with the eight taps of the position, then _mm_hadd_epi32; exact, because the taps of a position sum to 32768 or less, so no 32-bit overflow. The scalar loop finishes the remainder.
silk_resampler_private_IIR_FIR() takes the scratch arena that its ALLOC draws from.
silk_resampler_private_down_FIR() takes the scratch arena that its ALLOC draws from.
Only the RESAMPLER_DOWN_ORDER_FIR2 single-fraction interpolation remains (decimation by 3, 4 or 6), with the order a constant.
silk_resampler_private_up2_HQ_wrapper() is removed (no 2x upsampling resampler mode).

silk_resampler_frac_FIR_12 is [ 12 ][ 8 ]: row t holds the four taps of fraction t followed by those of fraction 11 - t in reverse order, which are the same values upstream reads from two table rows, so one vector load replaces the indexed reads.
silk_Resampler_3_4_COEFS, silk_Resampler_2_3_COEFS and silk_Resampler_1_2_COEFS are removed (48 kHz API rate).
silk_Resampler_1_4_COEFS and silk_Resampler_1_6_COEFS are removed (16 kHz internal rate only).
silk_resampler_frac_FIR_12 is declared [ 12 ][ RESAMPLER_ORDER_FIR_12 ] (eight taps per fractional position, see resampler_rom.c).
RESAMPLER_DOWN_ORDER_FIR0, RESAMPLER_DOWN_ORDER_FIR1 and the 3:4, 2:3 and 1:2 coefficient tables are removed.
silk_Resampler_1_4_COEFS and silk_Resampler_1_6_COEFS are removed (16 kHz internal rate only).
The FIR_Order and FIR_Fracs fields are removed (one decimation filter, RESAMPLER_DOWN_ORDER_FIR2).
silk_shell_decoder() splits a single pulse with ec_dec_icdf2() (its table is {icdf0, 0}): the same symbols without the search loop.
Loops over the bands, filter taps or small state arrays (at most 21 or 16 trips) carry SHORT_LOOP.
silk_stereo_LR_to_MS() takes the scratch arena that its ALLOCs draw from, no sampling rate or frame length (a 20 ms frame at 16 kHz) and keeps one prediction and one mid-only flag.
silk_stereo_find_predictor() takes no length: a frame is MAX_FRAME_LENGTH samples.
No run-time architecture field in silk_encoder_state or silk_decoder_state; no DTX state (useDTX, inDTX, noSpeechCounter) in silk_encoder_state.
silk_PLC_struct loses enable_deep_plc.

silk_LP_state and the variable low-pass, bandwidth switching, internal rate range and prefill fields (sLP, allow_bandwidth_switch, prev_API_fs_Hz, maxInternal_fs_Hz, minInternal_fs_Hz, desiredInternal_fs_Hz, prefillFlag) are removed.

silk_encoder_state describes the one configuration the encoder runs (16 kHz internal rate, four 5 ms subframes, order 16, one frame per packet, independent coding): the sampling rate, frame, subframe and LTP memory lengths, pitch window, subframe count, packet size and frame count, prediction order, the codebook and iCDF pointers, constant-bitrate flag, input index, previous lag and signal type for delta coding and the saved control values (the API rate, channel counts, FEC flag and target rate) are removed; the per-frame arrays (VAD and LBRR flags, LBRR indices and pulses, stereo indices and mid-only flag) hold one frame; LBRR_flags is LBRR_pending.
silk_Transition_LP_B_Q28 and silk_Transition_LP_A_Q28 are removed.
silk_Transition_LP_B_Q28 and silk_Transition_LP_A_Q28 are removed.
MAX_BANDWIDTH_SWITCH_DELAY_MS is removed.
silk_LPC_analysis_filter() is called without the arch argument.
silk_NSQ_del_dec_sse4_1() is renamed silk_NSQ_del_dec() and takes the scratch arena; the C twin NSQ_del_dec.c is deleted (the build requires SSE4.1, so it never ran).

The quantizer decision is branchless: a per-frame table (silk_nsq_candidate_table) holds the q1, q2 and rate-distortion terms by q1_Q0, and dither and swap masks replace the sign and rd1 < rd2 branches; all values are the ones the upstream branches select.

The warped shaping filter keeps its states side by side and sums the noise feedback as one vector dot product (AR coefficients zero past the order): same additions, reordered exactly within 32-bit wraparound.
The per-sample sample-state array is a fixed local array instead of an ALLOC.
The subframe length, subframe count, LTP memory and the prediction order (16, so the order-10 branch is removed) are constants.
silk_VAD_GetSA_Q8_sse4_1() is renamed silk_VAD_GetSA_Q8() and loses the arch argument; the band buffer X is a fixed local array of MAX_FRAME_LENGTH + MAX_FRAME_LENGTH / 4 samples instead of an ALLOC.
The frame is the constant 20 ms (MAX_FRAME_LENGTH): the 10 ms smoothing is removed, and the function returns nothing.

silk_VQ_WMat_EC_sse4_1() is renamed silk_VQ_WMat_EC() and loses the arch argument; its C twin VQ_WMat_EC.c is deleted, because the build requires SSE4.1 and the C version never ran. It takes no subframe length (MAX_SUB_FRAME_LENGTH).
opus_packet_parse() implements parsing without self-delimited framing, padding output or packet offset (multistream and extensions only); encode_size() removed.

Requests limited to reset, gain (set only) and final range; the gain query, complexity (deep PLC), bandwidth, sample rate, pitch, last packet duration, phase inversion and extension requests are removed.
No run-time architecture field; silk_Decode() is called without one.
No create/destroy, opus_decode24(), DRED or packet extension parsing; opus_decode_native() is private.

The decoded frame size checks use celt_packet_check(); the unreachable bandwidth fallback checks are removed (the TOC byte yields only NB/MB/WB for SILK-only and one of the five bandwidths otherwise).

opus_decode() takes the caller's scratch (OPUS_SCRATCH_BYTES) and passes it through opus_decode_native() and opus_decode_frame() to SILK and CELT; a static assertion checks the decoder's worst case against OPUS_SCRATCH_BYTES.
48 kHz output only: opus_decoder_init() refuses other rates, the state has no sampling rate, and the frame sizes, smooth_fade() and the SILK and CELT setup use 48 kHz.
The CELT decoder's channels, band range, reset, mode and final range go through the celt.h accessors instead of the varargs ctl.

Reduced to the voice profile: 48 kHz, VOIP, one 20 ms VBR frame per packet, 16-bit input, always coded as full-band hybrid (SILK wideband plus CELT bands 17-20). The packets equal those of the earlier maiopus encoder wherever that coded full-band hybrid, which includes every MaiCord setting; elsewhere (it chose CELT-only or SILK-only packets, or a lower audio bandwidth) the packets differ.

Removed: multi-frame repacketizing, CBR padding, the AUDIO and restricted applications, forced mode, bandwidth and channels, signal and voice ratio hints, LFE, surround masking, tonality analysis, float and 24-bit input, create/destroy.
Requests: bitrate, complexity, in-band FEC (0 or 1), packet loss and VBR constraint (all set only), and lookahead; no reset (OPUS_ENCODER_RESET_START is removed) and no final range.
No DTX: every frame is coded; compute_frame_energy(), decide_dtx_mode(), the activity and peak energy tracking and the zero-byte SILK return are removed.

No run-time architecture field; celt_encoder_init(), hp_cutoff() and silk_biquad_alt_stride2() take none. silk_InitEncoder() and silk_Encode() return nothing (they cannot fail), silk_Encode() takes no sample count, and the SILK settings structure has no input rate, payload size, DRED or constant-bitrate field.

The CELT encoder's complexity, loss rate and per-frame settings go through celt_encoder_set_complexity(), celt_encoder_set_loss(), celt_encoder_mode() and celt_encoder_prepare() instead of the varargs ctl.

opus_encode() (opus_encode_native() and opus_encode_frame_native() merged) takes the caller's scratch (OPUS_SCRATCH_BYTES) and passes it to SILK and CELT; a static assertion checks the encoder's worst case against OPUS_SCRATCH_BYTES.

Removed: CELT-only and SILK-only packets, the mode and audio bandwidth decisions (mode and bandwidth threshold tables, compute_stereo_width() and the stereo width state), SILK bandwidth switching, the CELT/SILK transition redundancy and prefill (compute_redundancy_bytes(), the 5 ms redundant frames, the CELT reset and prefill, prev_mode, silk_bw_switch, first), gen_toc() (the table of contents is constant: 0x78 plus the stereo bit), the plc frame for a buffer under 3 bytes, and the delay buffer beyond the 4 ms delay compensation.
decide_fec() compares the rate with the full-band in-band FEC threshold only; upstream lowers the audio bandwidth until FEC fits, which this encoder never does.

opus_encode() requires max_data_bytes = 1275; opus_encoder_ctl() takes a bitrate of 6000-510000 (no OPUS_AUTO or OPUS_BITRATE_MAX, no clamping) and a complexity of 1-10; OPUS_SET_VBR_CONSTRAINT is accepted and has no effect (hybrid frames are bounded by the SILK bit limit); the user and coded bitrate are one field.
Keeps the mode constants and align(); repacketizer, extension, multistream and private encoder/decoder declarations removed.
